target_customer: B2B sales, marketing and customer success teams that pay for a workspace to share content with buyers
problem: Sellers scatter demos, decks and references across tools; buyers want a single personalized place to evaluate and onboard. Enable Us offers digital sales rooms with AI-targeted content.
product_category: Digital sales rooms and buyer enablement

technical_complexity.rationale: Content workspace with video capture and recommendation features, standard SaaS engineering.

defensibility.rationale: The category was new but easy to enter; many vendors later launched digital sales rooms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Mindtickle partnered with Enable Us in 2022 and bought it in May 2023 to add a digital sales room.

market_need_then: Remote selling in 2020 and 2021 pushed buyers to self-serve evaluation; the company launched on Product Hunt in 2021 as Referenceable.

branding.domain_note: Used enable.us and enableus.com; originally launched as Referenceable.

rebrands.why: Not stated; trademark filings show REFERENCEABLE (April 2021) and ENABLE (April 2022)

brand_strength.rationale: Won G2 awards in October 2022 per YC page, but no press on the brand itself and the name is generic.

pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from name change and YC description, treat as unverified

outcome_analysis: Enable Us began as Referenceable and became a digital sales room product, raising about 4.5 million dollars in December 2021 after YC Winter 2021. It won G2 awards in 2022 and partnered with Mindtickle, which then acquired it in May 2023 for undisclosed terms. A small raise and quick sale suggest a product-feature outcome rather than a standalone category leader.
notes: Founders not named on pages fetched, left empty. Seed investor lists conflict across Seedtable, ZoomInfo and VCBacked; only investors named in more than one are listed. CB Insights shows 5.13M over six rounds, unverified. YC page lists the funding news under both Oct 2022 and Dec 2021; Dec 2021 used. The Referenceable-to-Enable rename and pivot are inferred from trademark filings and the Product Hunt URL in the YC description, not a company statement.
